subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: What proof path should gate the remaining post-#65085 heartbeat routing investigation for #99912?
rationale: Current source and tests cover the expected per-agent path, but the reporter provided fresh post-fix evidence; automation should not queue another fix until maintainers choose the live reproduction standard for the remaining failure.

options.title: Run current-main Docker repro
options.body: Reproduce the reporter's multi-agent heartbeat setup on current main, capture the wake target and created session key, and only then queue the narrow fix.

options.title: Ask for redacted config and logs
options.body: If maintainers cannot reproduce directly, request the reporter's redacted `openclaw.json`, heartbeat status, and gateway logs before changing code.

options.title: Close after fixed proof
options.body: Close only if current-main live proof shows the secondary heartbeat creates and reads from the secondary agent's workspace/session under the same setup.

recommendation.title: Run current-main Docker repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reporter's multi-agent heartbeat setup on current main, capture the wake target and created session key, and only then queue the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged #65085 cron reload fix is the closest shipped behavior and gives the best starting point for a current-main repro comparison.
